purpose: Canonical ingestion contract for observed predictive-keyboard rabbithole runs into MCT/GARAS.

evidence_policy.observed_vs_inferred: Observed values MUST be stored separately from inferred labels or reconstructed states.
evidence_policy.screenshots_or_video: When available, retain frame/time references for every reconstructed prediction step.
evidence_policy.cross_device_claims: Cross-device or cross-provider coherence requires independent observations and matched controls; shared semantics alone are insufficient.
evidence_policy.transfer_claims: Information transfer requires independent canary evidence and controlled exclusion of ordinary synchronization channels.
